data.title: "Partnership Information" goes to a page about existing partners, not about how to become one

data.detail: Leave trigger: "no price, length or dates after three pages." I went through the home page, What We Do, the full Cultural Connections page (including the FAQ) and the Partners page, and saw no price, trip length, dates, group size, or safety/insurance info anywhere. "Partnership Information" led to a page about existing partners rather than how to start a program, and my patience ran out. I did see contact buttons (Contact Us, Group Information, Get In Touch) but didn't open them.
